description: XBRL financials from 10-K/10-Q filings (SEC), AS FILED. One row = one concept at one period end. S&P 500 refreshed three times a week; any other company in SEC's ticker list is read live on first request (USD only) and stored. coverage_warning explains an empty result. On 10-Qs, frame (e.g. CY2025Q3) marks a quarter's own value; no frame usually = year-to-date. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fundamentals

category.description: metrics: EPS, share counts. entity: dei shares.

fiscal_year.description: Year the financials describe, not filing year.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on sort_by's date (period_end default).

name: get_fundamentals
